wiki_article:
**Hexagonal Contributor License v1.0 — Rhys Owens — Lunar Arm** is a record **WITHHELD** from harvest as a confirmed wrong-object mismatch.

The record's title claims a contributor license. Its seated body is *"Rhys Owens — The Lunar Arm of New Human"*, an archetypal and mythopoetic analysis of the Lunar Principle — a different work entirely, and one seated in its own right at #1358 as part of the v3.0 license.

The audit ruled the mismatch on 31 July 2026 with the directive *"Withhold until the actual v1.0 license is seated."* **That directive went unexecuted until 5 August 2026**, when MANUS found the record still serving the wrong work and the withholding was performed. The v1.0 license itself is not held anywhere in the archive; the siblings at #1357 and #1358 indicate the form it would take. The record stands as a typed statement of the mismatch rather than a silent substitution, and the seated bytes are retained under the non-destruction rule.
